_Last updated: September 2026_

## What we collect
When you contact us we store the details you provide (name, email, phone, project notes) so we can reply and manage your enquiry.

## How we use it
To respond to enquiries, prepare proposals and — if you opt in — send our monthly studio notes.

## Sharing
We never sell your data. It is shared only with the tools we use to run the studio (email, forms) under their own privacy terms.

## Your rights
Email hello@woodexinterior.com to access, correct or delete your data at any time.
